title: What makes you come alive?
subtitle: Consider what activities, projects, or work energize and excite you.

title: What are the things you naturally excel at?
subtitle: Identify the skills or talents that you've always been good at or that others often compliment you for.

title: What do you believe about the world?
subtitle: Think about your core beliefs, values, and philosophies that guide your decisions.

title: When have you felt the most fulfilled and satisfied?
subtitle: Reflect on specific instances in your life when you've felt a deep sense of accomplishment and fulfillment.

title: What impact do you want to make on the world or in the lives of others?
subtitle: Envision the difference you wish to make, or the legacy you want to leave behind.

title: What would you do even if you were not getting paid for it?
subtitle: Consider what you are passionate about that you would willingly do for free because it brings you joy or satisfaction.

title: Who are the people you admire the most and why?
subtitle: Identify the qualities in others that resonate with you, and consider why these traits are meaningful to you.

title: What has been a common thread in some of your most joyful and powerful experiences?
subtitle: Reflect on patterns or commonalities in those experiences that have brought you great joy or a sense of power.

title: What are the challenges or hardships that you feel most driven to solve or overcome?
subtitle: Consider the issues you feel strongly about and are motivated to address or fix.

title: If fear or failure were not an issue what would you pursue?
subtitle: Visualize what you would dare to dream or do if there were no risks involved.

title: What is a cause or belief that you would stand up for no matter what?
subtitle: Identify the convictions you hold so strongly that you would defend them under any circumstances.

title: When you are at your best what does that look like?
subtitle: Consider your qualities, actions, and attitudes when you're operating at your fullest potential.

title: What would make you feel that you have lived a fulfilling life?
subtitle: Visualize what you would need to achieve or experience to feel that your life has been fully lived.
